stories.summary: A reflection on how knowledge and awareness shape (and limit) each person's perception of reality.
stories.text: Each of us lives dependent and bound by our individual knowledge and our awareness. All that is what we call "reality". However, both knowledge and awareness are equivocal. One's reality might be another's illusion. We all live inside our own fantasies.
stories.title: Itachi — Reality and Illusion

stories.summary: A cold declaration of utilitarianism and the belief that winning is the only thing that matters.
stories.text: I've never once thought of you as an ally. Not you. Not Kushida. Not Hirata. All people are nothing but tools. It doesn't matter how it's done. It doesn't matter what needs to be sacrificed. In this world, winning is everything. As long as I win in the end… that's all that matters.
stories.title: Ayanokōji — All People Are Tools

stories.summary: L reflects on the nature of different kinds of "monsters" and admits he is one of them.
stories.text: There are many types of monsters that scare me: Monsters who cause trouble without showing themselves, monsters who abduct children, monsters who devour dreams, monsters who suck blood… and then, monsters who tell nothing but lies. Lying monsters are a real nuisance: They are much more cunning than others. They pose as humans even though they have no understanding of the human heart; they eat even though they've never experienced hunger; they study even though they have no interest in academics; they seek friendship even though they do not know how to love. If I were to encounter such monsters, I would likely be eaten by them… because in truth, I am that monster.
stories.title: L — The Monster Who Lies

stories.summary: Madara's bleak worldview about the inevitability of pain, conflict and the duality of existence.
stories.text: Wake up to reality! Nothing ever goes as planned in this accursed world. The longer you live, the more you realize that the only things that truly exist in this reality are merely pain, suffering and futility. Listen… Everywhere you look in this world, wherever there is light, there will always be shadows to be found as well. As long as there is a concept of victors, the vanquished will also exist. The selfish intent of wanting to preserve peace initiates wars, and hatred is born in order to protect love. There are nexuses, causal relationships that cannot be separated. I want to sever the fate of this world. A world of only victors. A world of only peace. A world of only love. I will create such a world. I am… the ghost of the Uchiha. For truly this reality… is a hell.
stories.title: Madara — Wake Up to Reality

stories.summary: Another classic Itachi reflection on how people define reality through what they accept as true.
stories.text: People live their lives bound by what they accept as correct and true. That is how they define "reality". But what does it mean to be "correct" or "true"? Merely vague concepts… Their "reality" may all be a mirage. Can we consider them to simply be living in their own world, shaped by their beliefs?
stories.title: Itachi — Bound by Beliefs

stories.summary: Erwin inspira seus soldados a enfrentar a morte certa dando significado ao sacrifício.
stories.text: Everything that you thought had meaning… every hope, dream, or moment of happiness… none of it matters as you lie bleeding out on the battlefield. None of it changes what a speeding rock does to a body. We all die. But does that mean our lives are meaningless? Does that mean that there was no point in our being born? Would you say that of our slain comrades? What about their lives? Were they meaningless? They were not! Their memory serves as an example to us all! The courageous fallen! The anguished fallen! Their lives have meaning because we, the living, refuse to forget them! And as we ride to certain death, we trust our successors to do the same for us! Because my soldiers do not buckle or yield when faced with the cruelty of this world! My soldiers push forward! My soldiers scream out! My soldiers RAGE!
stories.title: Erwin Smith — My Soldiers, Rage!

stories.summary: Light se declara Kira e justifica sua missão de criar um novo mundo.
stories.text: That's right. I am Kira. And what can you do? Kill me right here? Hear this: I'm not only Kira, but I am also God of the new world! Kira has become law in the world we now live. He is the one who's maintaining order. I have become justice. The only hope for mankind. Kill me? Is that really the right thing to do? Since Kira's appearance six years ago, wars have stopped and global crime rates have been reduced by over 70%. But… it's not enough. This world is still rotten with too many rotten people. Somebody has to do this! And when I first got that notebook all those years ago, I knew I had to do it—no, I was the only one who could. The only one who can create a new world is me.
stories.title: Light Yagami — God of the New World

stories.summary: Pain explica por que a guerra e o ódio nunca terminam.
stories.text: We are both of the same breed. After all… motives for war are of no consequence. Religion, ideology, resources, land, grudges, love, or just because… No matter how pathetic the reason, it’s enough to start a war. War will never cease to exist… reasons can be thought up after the fact. Human nature pursues strife. In this world of ours, there is no real peace. Peace is nothing but an illusion. As long as humans exist, hatred will also exist. You and I are simply seeking peace. The difference is the peace you want is based on your own perspective, while mine is based on mine. You see me as a criminal, but to me, you are the same. We are but ordinary men driven to act in the name of revenge that we deem to be justice. However, when we take revenge in the name of justice, that same justice will breed only more revenge… and trigger a cycle of hatred. The world of ninja is ruled by hatred… and nothing else.
stories.title: Pain — The Cycle of Hatred

stories.summary: O Major declara seu amor absoluto pela guerra em todas as formas.
stories.text: Gentlemen, I love war. Gentlemen, I… love war. Gentlemen… I SO LOVE WAR! I love holocausts. I love blitzkriegs. I love defensive lines. I love sieges, charges, mop-up operations, and retreats. Wars across prairies, in streets, in trenches, in grasslands, in frozen tundras, through deserts, on the sea, in the air… I love every act of war that can occur upon this earth. I love blasting the enemy to smithereens with artillery salvos that thunder across the lines of battle. My heart leaps with joy whenever a soldier is tossed high into the air and cut to pieces. Gentlemen… all I ask for is war, war so grand as to make Hell itself tremble.
stories.title: The Major — I Love War

stories.summary: Griffith fala sobre o poder e o preço de um sonho ambicioso.
stories.text: One man's dream can hold dominion over the entire world, for one who dedicates his life to the forging of a single sword. While many can pursue their dreams in solitude, other dreams are like great storms blowing hundreds, even thousands of dreams apart in their wake. Dreams breathe life into men and can cage them in suffering. Men live and die by their dreams. But long after they have been abandoned, they still smoulder deep in men's hearts. Some see nothing more than life and death. They are dead, for they have no dreams.
stories.title: Griffith — One Man's Dream

stories.summary: O canto completo da Reality Marble de Archer.
stories.text: I am the bone of my sword. Steel is my body, and fire is my blood. I have created over a thousand blades. Unknown to death, nor known to life. Have withstood pain to create many weapons. Yet, those hands will never hold anything. So, as I pray… Unlimited Blade Works!
stories.title: Archer — Unlimited Blade Works

stories.summary: Edward reflete sobre a necessidade da dor e do sacrifício para crescer.
stories.text: A lesson without pain is meaningless. That's because no one can gain without sacrificing something. But by enduring that pain and overcoming it, he shall obtain a powerful, unmatched heart. A fullmetal heart. Humankind cannot gain anything without first giving something in return. To obtain, something of equal value must be lost. That is alchemy’s first law of Equivalent Exchange.
stories.title: Edward Elric — A Fullmetal Heart

stories.summary: Spike explica por que está indo para um confronto que pode matá-lo.
stories.text: I'm not going there to die. I'm going to find out if I'm really alive. Men only think about the past right before their death, as if they were searching frantically for proof that they were alive. I've been living in a dream for too long. It's time to wake up. Whether I live or die… I need to know.
stories.title: Spike Spiegel — Finding Out If I'm Alive

stories.summary: Rem encoraja Subaru a recomeçar mesmo depois de tudo desmoronar.
stories.text: It’s easy to give up… But… It doesn’t suit you, Subaru-kun. Let’s start from here. From the beginning… No, from zero! Even if everything is lost, even if the world turns against you, you still have the strength to stand up again. I believe in you. So please… don’t give up on yourself.
stories.title: Rem — Start From Zero

stories.summary: Thorfinn rejeita o ciclo de violência e declara que não tem inimigos.
stories.text: We don’t know anything about each other. We hold no grudges. So why do we have to fight each other? It’s ridiculous. There is absolutely no reason for all these people to gather and shed blood. We met for the first time today. You guys are not my enemies. No one is my enemy. I have no enemies. The only people who should be fighting are the leaders. There’s no need for us to die for their quarrel.
stories.title: Thorfinn — I Have No Enemies
